### Page note: https://www.bts.gov/newsroom/air-travel-consumer-report-july-2023-numbers
Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page**  
Air Travel Consumer Report: July 2023 Numbers – https://www.bts.gov/newsroom/air-travel-consumer-report-july-2023-numbers

**Evidence**  
- “In July 2023, the **10 marketing network carriers** reported **638,995 scheduled domestic flights**, **15,875 (2.5 %)** of which were canceled.”  
- “In **June 2023**, airlines scheduled **613,577 domestic flights**, **12,856 (2.1 %)** of which were canceled.”  
- “In **July 2022**, airlines scheduled **618,790 domestic flights**, **11,133 (1.8 %)** of which were canceled.”  
- “The **623,120 flights operated** in July 2023 were **102.54 %** of the **607,657 flights operated** in July 2022. Operated flights in July 2023 were **up 2.54 % year‑over‑year** from the 607,657 flights operated in July 2022 and **up 3.73 % month‑over‑month** from 600,721 flights operated in June 2023.”  
- “In July 2023, reporting marketing carriers posted an **on‑time arrival rate of 69.6 %**, down from **71.3 % in June 2023** and **74.9 % in July 2022**.”  
- **Highest Marketing Carrier On‑Time Arrival Rates July 2023 (ATCR Table 1)**  
  1. Hawaiian Airlines – 82.5 %  
  2. Alaska Airlines Network – 81.2 %  
  3. Delta Air Lines Network – 76.1 %  
- **Lowest Marketing Carrier On‑Time Arrival Rates July 2023 (ATCR Table 1)**  
  1. JetBlue Airways – 49.5 %  
  2. Frontier Airlines – 53.5 %  
  3. Spirit Airlines – 60.8 %  
- “In July 2023, reporting marketing carriers canceled **2.5 %** of their scheduled domestic flights, higher than **2.1 % in June 2023** and **1.8 % in July 2022**.”  
- **Highest Marketing Carrier Rates of Canceled Flights June 2023 (ATCR Table 6)**  
  1. JetBlue Airways – 6.8 %  
  2. Frontier Airlines – 4.5 %  
  3. United Airlines Network – 4.5 %  
- “In July 2023, airlines reported **63 tarmac delays of more than three hours** on domestic flights, compared to **74 tarmac delays of more than three hours** on domestic flights reported in June 2023.”  
- “In July 2023, airlines reported **three tarmac delays of more than four hours** on international flights, compared to **14 tarmac delays of more than four hours** on international flights reported in June 2023.”  
- “In July 2023, reporting marketing carriers handled **45.6 million bags** and posted a **mishandled baggage rate of 0.75 %**, higher than **0.70 % in June 2023** and **0.64 % in July 2022**.”  
- “In July 2023, reporting marketing carriers reported **checking 81,536 wheelchairs and scooters** and mishandling **1,137**, for a rate of **1.39 % mishandled wheelchairs and scooters**, lower than **1.45 % in June 2023** and **1.63 % in July 2022**.”  
- “For the second quarter of 2023, the **10 U.S. reporting marketing carriers** posted an **involuntary denied boarding, or bumping, rate of 0.36 per 10 000 passengers**, higher than the **0.30 in the fourth quarter of 2022**.”  
- “In July 2023, carriers reported **one incident involving the death, injury, or loss of an animal** while traveling by air, equal to the one report filed in June 2023.”  
- “The Department continues to receive a high volume of air travel service complaints against airlines and ticket agents...” (no numeric totals).  
- “The ATCR has been delayed primarily because of the time needed to review and process these consumer complaints.”  

**Coverage**  
- Entities: ten marketing network carriers (names given for top on‑time and cancellation rates); other carriers appear in general statistics but not listed by name.  
- Years covered: 2022, 2023 (specifically June 2023, July 2023, and references to July 2022 and June 2022).  
- Conditions: monthly airline operational data, on‑time arrivals, cancellations, malfunctions, mis‑handled baggage, wheelchairs/scooters, tarmac delays, bumping, animal incidents.  
- Scope of data: monthly totals of flights operated, flights scheduled, cancellation percentages, on‑time arrival rates, baggage processed, etc.  
- The list is **complete** for the facts explicitly presented in the supplied page; no hidden tables are referenced but their content is not shown here.  

**Missing**  
- Total consumer submissions (complaints, inquiries, opinions) for any airline in June 2023.  
- Total consumer submissions for any airline in July 2023.  
- Percent (%) increase in total consumer submissions between June 2023 and July 2023.  

**Next links**  
- https://www.bts.gov/newsroom/air-travel-consumer-report-june-2023-numbers – potential source of June 2023 consumer submission data.  
- https://www.transportation.gov/airconsumer/airline-customer-service-dashboard – dashboard that may display complaint totals by airline.  
- https://www.bts.gov/search?q=consumer+submission+reports+2023 – search page that may lead to the full ATCR data set.  
- https://www.bts.gov/newsroom/air-travel-consumer-report-august-2023-numbers – next month release (not required for current question but offers broader context).
